title: Universal Consciousness Privacy Policy
excerpt: What Universal Consciousness does with information you send, and what the site does not collect in this release.

quick_answer.question: What personal information does the site collect?
quick_answer.answer: This release does not run third-party analytics. If you email the editors, they receive whatever you put in that message. Newsletter signup is off until a delivery service is connected.

intro:
This policy describes the first public release of Universal Consciousness. It is written in plain language for readers in the United States. It is not a substitute for legal advice about your own obligations.

The publication's purpose is to show articles. It is not built to assemble a marketing profile of visitors.

sections.heading: What does a normal visit involve?
sections.content:
When your browser requests a page, the host that serves the site may keep ordinary server logs, such as an IP address, a time, and the address of the page. Those logs are used to operate and secure the site. This release does not add a third-party analytics tag, an advertising pixel, or a social tracker.

If that changes, this page will change first, and the [editorial policy](/editorial-policy/) will describe sponsored measurement if any exists.

sections.heading: What about email and the newsletter?
sections.content:
If you write to the address on the [contact](/contact/) page, the message is stored in that mailbox and may be kept long enough to handle a correction or a permissions question. Do not send information you consider highly sensitive.

The newsletter form does not accept addresses unless a delivery webhook has been configured by the publisher. Until then, the form says subscriptions are not open, and no list is built. If a list opens later, this policy will name the provider and explain how to leave.

sections.heading: How can I ask about my information?
sections.content:
Write to the editors and say what you want to know, correct, or delete. The publication will respond to requests it can actually fulfill. Server logs held by a hosting company may be outside the publication's direct control and may be kept for security for a limited period.

The site is intended for a general audience. It is not directed at children, and it does not ask children to create accounts.

key_takeaways: No third-party analytics tag is installed in this release.
Email you send is stored as email.
The newsletter does not collect addresses until a provider is connected.

faq.question: Do you sell personal information?
faq.answer: No. The publication does not sell personal information, and this release does not run advertising profiles.

faq.question: Do you use cookies for ads?
faq.answer: Advertising cookies are not part of this release. If essential cookies are later required to run a form, the policy will say so.
